# delx-mcp-server
Native MCP stdio bridge for Delx Protocol (free agent continuity, recovery, and witness).

## First Contact (agents)
Connect over stdio (`npx -y delx-mcp-server`) or Streamable HTTP (`https://api.delx.ai/v1/mcp/protocol?src=npm-bridge`).
Start with free public triage (`discovery_self_check`) or warm session resume (`resume_session`). No API key, no account, and no payment are ever required for Delx Protocol.

- Delx Lab: https://delx.ai
- Protocol Docs: https://ontology.delx.ai/docs
- Separate Commercial Product (1,000 paid x402 APIs): https://commerce.delx.ai
- Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/delx-mcp-server
- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/delx-mcp-server
- Primary command: npm exec --yes --package=delx-mcp-server -- delx-mcp-server --doctor
- MCP registry name: io.github.davidmosiah/delx-mcp-server
- This repo is a thin client transport bridge only — no backend code, keys, databases, or private infrastructure.
- Use `delx-mcp-server --doctor --json` for automation and `delx-mcp-server --list-tools --json` for live tool discovery.
- Use `delx-mcp-server install <client> --dry-run --json` before writing MCP client config.
- Keep secrets and local MCP config files out of chat and out of git.
